title: Choosing Ads
statementMd:
One social network developer recently suggested a new algorithm of choosing ads for users.

There are $*n*$ slots which advertisers can buy. It is possible to buy a segment of consecutive slots at once. The more slots you own, the bigger are the chances your ad will be shown to users.

Every time it is needed to choose ads to show, some segment of slots is picked by a secret algorithm. Then some advertisers are chosen. The only restriction is that it should be guaranteed for advertisers which own at least $*p*$% of slots composing this segment that their ad will be shown.

From the other side, users don't like ads. So it was decided to show no more than ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1bc337dc838aaf4cb888794bfd7335875815ad18.png) ads at once. You are asked to develop a system to sell segments of slots and choose ads in accordance with the rules described above.

## Input

The first line of the input contains three integers $*n*$, $*m*$ and $*p*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 150 000, 20 ≤ *p* ≤ 100$) — the number of slots, the number of queries to your system and threshold for which display of the ad is guaranteed.

Next line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 150 000)$, where the $*i*$-th number means id of advertiser who currently owns the $*i*$-th slot.

Next $*m*$ lines contain queries descriptions. Each description is of one of the following forms:

- `1 l r id` ($1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *id* ≤ 150 000$) — advertiser $*id*$ bought all slots in a range from $*l*$ to $*r*$ inclusive;
- `2 l r` ($1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r*$) — you need to choose advertisers for segment $[*l*, *r*]$.

## Output

For each query of the second type answer should be printed in a separate line. First integer of the answer should be the number of advertisements that will be shown ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/594d68d450c6e46a07817cd2b8464ce07dfdbb98.png). Next $*cnt*$ integers should be advertisers' ids.

It is allowed to print one advertiser more than once, but each advertiser that owns at least ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fe34e8b1cc20989935fc8ac482138d67059c322e.png) slots of the segment from $*l*$ to $*r*$ should be in your answer.

## Note

Samples demonstrate that you actually have quite a lot of freedom in choosing advertisers.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

某社交网络的开发者最近提出了一种为用户选择广告的新算法。

有 $*n*$ 个广告位，广告商可以购买这些广告位。可以一次性购买一段连续的广告位。拥有的广告位越多，广告被展示给用户的概率就越大。

每当需要选择要展示的广告时，秘密算法会选取一段广告位。然后，系统会选择一些广告商。唯一的限制是：对于拥有该广告位区间中至少 $*p*$% 广告位的广告商，必须保证其广告会被展示。

另一方面，用户不喜欢广告。因此决定一次最多展示 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1bc337dc838aaf4cb888794bfd7335875815ad18.png) 个广告。请你开发一个系统，按照上述规则出售广告位并选择广告。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ 和 $*p*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 150 000$，$20 ≤ *p* ≤ 100$）——广告位的数量、系统需要处理的查询数量，以及保证广告被展示的阈值。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 150 000$），其中第 $*i*$ 个数表示当前拥有第 $*i*$ 个广告位的广告商编号。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行包含查询描述。每个查询属于以下两种形式之一：

- `1 l r id`（$1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *id* ≤ 150 000）——广告商 $*id*$ 购买区间 $*l*$ 到 $*r*$（包含两端）的所有广告位；
- `2 l r`（$1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r*$）——你需要为区间 $[*l*, *r*]$ 选择广告商。

## 输出格式

对于每个第二种类型的查询，单独输出一行答案。答案的第一个整数应为将要展示的广告数量 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/594d68d450c6e46a07817cd2b8464ce07dfdbb98.png)。接下来的 $*cnt*$ 个整数应为广告商编号。

允许同一个广告商被输出多次，但对于区间 $*l*$ 到 $*r*$ 中拥有至少 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fe34e8b1cc20989935fc8ac482138d67059c322e.png) 个广告位的每个广告商，都必须出现在你的答案中。

## 说明

样例表明，你实际上拥有很大的自由来选择广告商。
